title: Waiting page: a read ask's title keeps a readable width between 521 and 700 px
why: Design check on #2559, 16:58 CST Nov 10 (design-reviewer opus): on main too, the read asks row's title is 0 px at 521, 61 at 600 and 161 at 700 px.
note: Cause: the date ("Answered Oct 28, 04:00 CDT") plus Show answer and Mark unread share its row. At 390 it wraps whole. Fix the same way as #2559's head: wrap below 701 px. Shots: triage scratchpad shots2/askd-*.png.
